home.title: Your friends, online again.
home.lead: Blobi is a desktop messenger for Linux, Windows and macOS. Your contacts live in their own window, chats open in tabs, and it is being built on XMPP, the open chat standard.
home.tryPresence: Try it: set your status in the contacts window, or switch the theme.
home.windowsTitle: Contacts in one window, conversations in another
home.demoLead: Click a contact to open a tab, send a nudge, or replay the chat. This is a scripted demo running in your browser, and nothing here is sent anywhere.
home.statusLead: Blobi has no public release yet. This list says where each part stands in the desktop prototype.
home.themesLead: Blobi includes two themes: Live Nostalgia Modern, and Blobi in light and dark. The other eight are community theme packs, and the Theme Studio editor is still in development.
home.closingTitle: Want to know when you can try it?
home.closingText: Leave your email and we will write once there is a build you can install.

waitlist.label: Email address
waitlist.consent: Email me about Blobi releases. I can unsubscribe at any time.
waitlist.note: We store your email on Blobi's own server and send the confirmation email through Zoho Mail.
waitlist.closed: The waitlist is not open yet. Check back soon.

footer.privacy: This site uses no cookies, analytics or third-party requests.

thanks.title: Check your inbox
thanks.text: We sent you an email. Open the link inside to confirm your place on the waitlist. If it doesn't arrive in a few minutes, look in your spam folder.

states.noscript: This page needs JavaScript to check your invitation. Keep the link: it is your invitation.
states.pending: This invitation is valid until {date}. You will be able to create your account when the app is available. Keep this link.
states.used: This invitation has already been used.
states.invalid: This invitation is not valid. Check that you copied the whole link.
states.missing: Open this page from the invitation link you received.
states.unavailable: Invitation checks are not available right now. Keep your link and try again later.
states.error: We could not check your invitation. Try again in a moment.
states.busy: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
